opening.argument: The promotion directs viewers to sign up, choose a package, and make payment, while presenting that purchase as access to mining coins and promised profit. It says the package includes “the cost of mining for coins” and that viewers will profit from OneCoin, tying payment to a claimed financial return. The opportunity is also framed as an income system built on referrals: viewers can earn passive income by recommending people, receive a 10 percent bonus for personally introducing someone, and obtain matching bonuses through four generations of referrals. Wealth-oriented language urges viewers to secure their position in a “once in a lifetime opportunity” and take action to improve their lives. The available evidence does not establish whether anyone enrolled or received the promised returns.
